text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The missed notes stood out
a little too much, didn't they?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
We can at least take comfort in the fact
that it did not devolve into total dissonanza.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I must express my gratitude to the musicisti
who guided this concerto.
choice_data_list: I think it was a performance full of character.
I should hone my skills so I can lead the concert

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"...Do you truly mean that?
Heh, in that case, I am glad."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Your words have filled
my broken heart once more.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: "Still, I can't keep taking your kindness and expectations for granted."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Next time, I shall seize victory...
and swear to deliver the ultimate concerto."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Let's aim for a concerto that is flawless, yet vivace.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: "Shall we devote ourselves thoroughly to an etude for that purpose?"
